headline.en: Check what you are about to load
headline.zh: 加载前，核对代码与签名

sub.en: AttestLoad signs a directory manifest and verifies the files before your loader proceeds. Use its CLI in CI or call guardLoad from an application that owns the loading step.
sub.zh: AttestLoad 为目录清单签名，并在加载前核对文件。可在 CI 中运行 CLI，也可由掌握加载入口的应用调用 guardLoad。

body.en: Rebuild file digests, executable modes and symlink metadata before verification.
body.zh: 验证时重新检查文件摘要、可执行权限和符号链接元数据。

body.en: Local Ed25519 and network-backed Sigstore signatures are separately identified.
body.zh: 本地 Ed25519 与需要联网的 Sigstore 签名明确区分。

body.en: guardLoad throws LoadRefused when verification or policy refuses the artifact.
body.zh: 校验或策略拒绝产物时，guardLoad 抛出 LoadRefused。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: This complete example creates a temporary skill and key, signs with local Ed25519, verifies it, then modifies the file. It does not contact Fulcio or Rekor.
note.zh: 完整示例创建临时 Skill 和密钥，使用本地 Ed25519 签名、验证，再修改文件。不调用 Fulcio 或 Rekor。

body.zh: 完整示例创建临时 Skill 和密钥，使用本地 Ed25519 签名、验证，再修改文件。不调用 Fulcio 或 Rekor。

cd attestload

limitations.en: Signature validity and content integrity do not establish that code is harmless. Review what the skill can execute.
limitations.zh: 签名有效和内容完整不等于代码无害，仍需审查 Skill 能执行的行为。

limitations.en: The demo validates local signing only; Sigstore transparency-log and identity flows were not exercised.
limitations.zh: 示例仅验证本地签名，没有运行 Sigstore 透明日志和身份流程。

limitations.en: A guarded check does not prevent later file changes unless the caller controls the check-to-execution boundary.
limitations.zh: 如果调用方没有控制检查到执行之间的边界，检查通过后文件仍可能变化。

body.en: A directory can change between review and installation. A signed manifest records the reviewed file set, while verification detects changed content and policy decides which signer identities your workflow accepts.
body.zh: 目录内容可能在审查和安装之间发生变化。签名清单记录文件集合，验证过程发现内容变更，策略则决定工作流接受哪些签名身份。

body.en: manifest.ts walks files into a content-addressed list. sbom.ts derives file-level or supported lockfile metadata; attest.ts adds provenance and signs canonical JSON. verify.ts recomputes the content and verifies the signature. policy.ts applies provenance and bound-signer rules; loader-guard.ts exposes the result to the caller.
body.zh: manifest.ts 将文件整理为带摘要的清单，sbom.ts 提取文件级或支持的锁文件元数据，attest.ts 加入来源信息并为规范化 JSON 签名。verify.ts 重新计算内容并验签，policy.ts 检查来源和绑定的签名身份，loader-guard.ts 向调用方提供结果。

title.en: Directory facts feed a policy-controlled load check
title.zh: 目录事实进入加载策略检查

body.en: manifest.ts walks files into a content-addressed list. sbom.ts derives file-level or supported lockfile metadata; attest.ts adds provenance and signs canonical JSON. verify.ts recomputes the content and verifies the signature. policy.ts applies provenance and bound-signer rules; loader-guard.ts exposes the result to the caller.
body.zh: manifest.ts 将文件整理为带摘要的清单，sbom.ts 提取文件级或支持的锁文件元数据，attest.ts 加入来源信息并为规范化 JSON 签名。verify.ts 重新计算内容并验签，policy.ts 检查来源和绑定的签名身份，loader-guard.ts 向调用方提供结果。

alt.en: Directory facts feed a policy-controlled load check
alt.zh: 目录事实进入加载策略检查

body.en: A verifier only gates loading when the application or CI workflow calls it and honors its result. It does not automatically intercept every agent. SPDX-lite and SLSA-lite describe the repository’s reduced metadata formats; they are not claims of full standards certification.
body.zh: 只有应用或 CI 主动调用并遵循验证结果，才能在加载前形成检查。工具不会自动拦截所有 Agent。SPDX-lite 和 SLSA-lite 表示本仓库的精简元数据格式，不代表完整标准认证。

body.en: Policy supports require_provenance, require_signature, allowed_identities and use_allowlist. Pin Ed25519 identities as ed25519:<SPKI-DER SHA-256>; Sigstore identities come from the verified certificate SAN. With no allowed_identities restriction, a valid self-signed local key does not establish a trusted publisher. Cold-start allowlisting requires a present intact unsigned manifest and a matching pinned artifact digest; a name-only entry is insufficient. --sigstore requires a usable OIDC token and network access; default signing may fall back to local Ed25519.
body.zh: 策略支持 require_provenance、require_signature、allowed_identities 和 use_allowlist。Ed25519 身份使用 ed25519:<SPKI-DER SHA-256> 固定；Sigstore 身份来自已验证证书的 SAN。未限制 allowed_identities 时，有效的自签本地密钥并不能证明可信发布者。冷启动白名单要求现有完整但未签名的清单，以及匹配的固定产物摘要；仅名称不够。--sigstore 需要可用 OIDC Token 和网络，默认签名可能回退到本地 Ed25519。

body.en: attest writes .attestload/attestation.json beside the files. verify returns 0 when policy accepts and 1 when blocked. The unsigned example intentionally blocks. For an application, import guardLoad from attestload and await it before the application executes or imports the directory’s code; checkLoad returns a decision without throwing.
body.zh: attest 将 .attestload/attestation.json 写在目录中。verify 在策略接受时返回 0，被拒绝时返回 1，未签名示例应被拒绝。应用可从 attestload 导入 guardLoad，在执行或导入目录代码之前 await；checkLoad 返回决策而不抛异常。

details.code:
node dist/cli.js attest ./examples/signed-skill --kind skill
node dist/cli.js verify ./examples/signed-skill --json
node dist/cli.js verify ./examples/unsigned-skill --json
